corrections.reason: The cross-reference is to Matthew 11:14 (ማቴ ፲፩ ፲፬), concerning John the Baptist coming in the spirit of Elijah; visually the numeral ten (፲) was misread as twenty (፳).
Joining across the line break from L13 (አል-) gives አልፏል (has passed). Visually only ፏል ። is printed on L14 without an extra ዋ.
Canonical Ge'ez Luke 1:21 reads ይጸልዩ (as confirmed by the Amharic gloss ይጸልዩለት ነበር in L13); the printed ጸ was misread as ዴ due to ink bleed at the base.
